positions.title: Software Engineer, Principal Member of Technical Staff
Software Engineer, Lead Member of Technical Staff
Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop and deliver customized solutions to early adopters of Digital Store mobile application.
* Hands on expert as well as advisory services engineer on new mobile application offering for ecommerce platform customers.
* Provide prototypes and estimates for customizations of mobile application.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Explored and defined requirements for a new product to display IT and business metrics to executives.
* Researched and prototyped mobile applications using various tools and techniques.
* Analyzed performance of mobile application and implemented improvements to reduce number of DOM elements. 
* Practiced Agile Methodologies with a recent role as Scrum Master for a team of 7 engineers.
* Resolved inconsistencies in the mobile product related to button press to improve usability.
* Delivered high quality UI experience on mobile and desktop, which was supported by a backend which is scalable, robust and multi-tenant aware.
* Designed, developed and tested new mobile web application for Android and iOS using Sencha Touch, J2EE, SpringSource, RESTful Web services and Hibernate. Used Sencha GXT for desktop administration tool.
* Provided support for customers, solutions, support and training teams.
* Attended conferences to demonstrate product and answer technical questions.
* Mentored entry-level engineers as well as performed code and design reviews of others.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Assumed project leader role for unified install, which was a complex melding of many mechanisms.  An iterative approach was taken with the help of remote engineers.
* Merged two separate installations into one using InstallAnywhere for the front-end.  Back-end portion of the install had to remain the same using shell scripts to perform the install.
* Analyzed multiple solutions for FIPS 140-2 compliance and implemented the appropriate solution for each case to ensure encryption of password storage. 
* Visited customer sites for beta testing.
* Designed and developed internationalization plan for Java application.
* Designed and developed install UI for eHealth install using InstallAnywhere.
* Developed topology applet for SPECTRUM to be displayed in a browser.
* Developed comparison view with color coding for comparing two configurations belonging to any two managed devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
* Designed and developed user management software for authorization and authentication of users using Java and LDAP.
* Established project plan for web operator.
* Assumed project leader role for web operator improvements related to look and feel and customizations.
* Developed integration install for Spectrum Security Manager.
* Analyzed performance of alarm servlet.
* Designed and developed reusable tab panel for Java application to allow for dock, undock and closing of panels.  Tab panel registration was done via XML file.
* Investigated fault tolerance for web servers.
* Performed code reviews and unit tests of other developers work.
* Involved in creating use cases and actors for new product.
* Attended user conferences to demonstrate products and answer technical questions.
* Visited customer sites for beta and usability testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
* Created and documented integration tools for all web applications to use in order to be consistent.
* Assumed project leader role for web based application connecting to distributed IT management software.
* Managed web application builds and modification requests.
* Provided help to testing, support and field engineers for problems related to web applications, worked with testing and development to resolve.
* Participated in design and code reviews.
* Assisted with setting up machines with web applications for trade shows.
* Designed and developed installation of web applications with tomcat.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Researched, designed and implemented launching applications from icons within platforms desktop.
* Developed server selection dialog so that applications could be launched from the user’s desktop and connect to distributed server utilizing list of servers from location service.
* Developed developer install with InstallShield to install required development environment, which included Cygwin32, Exceed Xserver and X development kit.
* Maintained web based key generation tool for installations using shell scripts on Unix.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
* Developed browser plug-ins, for Netscape and IE, for distribution of Cabletron software via the web.
* Performed usability testing with customers for changes to installation process. 
* Completed story board walk-through, design and functional specifications based on data from usability studies and group discussions.
* Designed interfaces for launching on-line manuals and HTML documents from within SPECTRUM, as well as creating project page, implementing and documenting the interface.
* Developed and debugged distributed installation for enterprise software application using C++ and shell scripts.

positions.title: Software Support Engineer I
positions.description:
* Assigned and tracked licenses for development software products as well as provided frontline support for technical questions related to software.
* Assisted in research and preparing justifications of software and hardware purchasing, as well as tracking progress from approval through final delivery.
* Maintained with analysis and debugging of installation and key generation tool code written in C, C++, and shell scripts.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: • Generated reports for management related to development modification requests.

projects.title: Digital Store solution
projects.description: Mobile (iPad) application for store associates to assist customers with searching and purchasing products through Demandware platform for items that may not be in the store.  Leverages the comprehensive consumer data, backend integrations and payment methods from Demandware Commerce.

projects.title: CA Executive Insight for Service Assurance
projects.description: Mobile (Phone and Tablet) application providing executives with real-time IT performance metrics and business metrics in a dashboard view.
